ablation.name: d9a_swd16_15ep
ablation.notes: D9a: Loss reweighting - increase style weight. single_step_swd_weight 12->16 (+33%). Theory: D7b/D8 all showed that architectural scaling REDUCES DINO-sty because extra capacity goes to content. The DINO-sty ceiling at 0.476 is a LOSS BALANCE limit, not capacity. By increasing SWD weight, we force the model to prioritize style distribution matching over content reconstruction. Expected: DINO-sty up, 1-LPIPS down (acceptable tradeoff per user: prioritize CLIP-S and DINO-sty). bs=96.
